verdict.rationale: Honeybadger ties deployments to error resolution and provides a GitHub/GitLab diff comparison of what changed since the last deploy, plus a BadgerQL query for errors since the last deploy, which supports associating errors with releases. However there is no evidence of a per-issue 'suspect commit' feature or an explicit 'first seen in release X' badge on individual errors. missing for 10: automated suspect-commit attribution per error, explicit 'first appeared in release' field on issue detail, independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
